parsed.summary: The patch introduces a legacy encoding format for session data when DEFAULT_HASHING_ALGORITHM is 'sha1'. The new test script attempts to reproduce the session issue.

issues.description: The approach of using legacy encoding format when DEFAULT_HASHING_ALGORITHM is 'sha1' is hacky and may not be the best solution. It could lead to maintenance issues in the future.
The new test script does not follow Django's project conventions, such as using Django's testing framework instead of subprocess calls.
